description: Combat rules (BattleRules.gd): enemy intents and boss charge-ups, Break (weakness hits), the party Link gauge and Unison Strike.

fields.name: weakness_bonus
fields.help: Extra damage for a hit on a weakness (damage type or element).

fields.name: boss_charge
fields.help: Bosses spend a turn charging their signature/ultimate (shown as an intent).

fields.name: charge_power_mult
fields.help: Damage multiplier of a charged strike.

fields.name: regular_charge_chance
fields.help: Chance a regular enemy winds up a heavy skill instead of using it at once.

fields.name: regular_charge_min_power
fields.help: Only skills at least this strong are charged.

fields.name: hero_hits
fields.help: Weakness hits that Break a hero or companion.

fields.name: combo_bonus
fields.help: Extra points when the weakness hit also triggers a combo.

fields.name: enabled
fields.help: Off = all enemy weaknesses are always shown.

fields.name: scholar_classes
fields.help: Classes whose Inspect reveals all weaknesses.

fields.name: scholar_traits
fields.help: Companion traits that do the same.

fields.name: damage_mult
fields.help: Multiplies the already-halved Defend damage.

fields.name: attacker_pips
fields.help: Break pips the attacker gains.

fields.name: counter_mult
fields.help: Counter vs a charged strike: share of a basic hit.

fields.name: skill_cost_mult
fields.help: Heroes pay this x a skill's listed MP/SP.

fields.name: cost_per_level
fields.help: Skill costs rise by this share per hero level (keeps pace with MP/SP pools).

fields.name: attack_restore
fields.help: Share of max MP and SP a hero's basic attack restores.

fields.name: defend_restore
fields.help: Share of max MP and SP a hero's Defend restores.

fields.name: riposte_bonus
fields.help: After a Perfect Guard, the hero's next action deals this much more.

fields.name: attack_weak_break
fields.help: Break points from a basic attack on a weakness (skills give 1).

fields.name: _doc
fields.help: Notes for designers.
